tracks.title: Powder Keg Cove
tracks.desc: base game: jaunty 6/8 sea shanty, concertina lead with fiddle answers, D dorian, 96 bpm (dotted quarter)

tracks.title: Light the Fuse
tracks.desc: fuse/wheel moments: hot G minor hornpipe, fiddle runs, stabbing brass, driving snare, 150 bpm

tracks.title: Moonlight Raid
tracks.desc: free spins: spooky nocturnal shanty, solo cello and ghost choir over drones, moonlit glock, ship's bell, D minor, 80 bpm; tension stem via intensity()

tracks.title: Davy Jones' Waltz
tracks.desc: hidden bonus: ethereal underwater waltz, music box + celesta + choir, D minor to F major, 90 bpm 3/4

tracks.title: Plunder Fanfare
tracks.desc: big-win celebration: triumphant cartoon brass march with accordion flourishes, Bb major, 120 bpm, 8 bars
